As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael's journey has brought him to Lee on the Solent in Hampshire to the training centre of Britain's fourth emergency service, Her Majesty's Coastguard. He finds out about their role in search and rescue and helps in one of their highly skilled operations: a mud rescue. Michael's next stop on his coastal travels is the great maritime city of Portsmouth. Here he meets the Queen's Harbour Master, whose office oversees more than 200,000 maritime movements through the port each year.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: The final leg of Michael's South Coast adventure begins in Fishbourne, the location of one of the most significant Roman sites in Britain. He takes in the astonishingly well preserved, almost 2,000-year-old mosaic floors and finds out how they may have been designed as Roman after-dinner entertainment. Heading into East Sussex, Michael makes for a British resort synonymous with seaside jaunts, Brighton.

Things get emotional when she decides to put the house up for sale and is forced to locate the treasured items that are her family's legacy.

Most of the Makers have never worked with edible crafts before, so it’s a real challenge.

In Inverclyde, the trauma team have rushed to 9-year-old David, who has sustained serious injuries to his legs after being thrown from his quad bike and impaled on to a metal fence. Meanwhile in rural Stirlingshire, 59-year-old Jacqui, a former nurse, has been found trapped in her car ten foot down an embankment with serious injuries.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Denise Drysdale takes a DNA test, and it’s no surprise to find her family hails from Scotland. But it is a shock to discover she also has DNA links to Northern Ireland. Denise finds her maternal 3 times great grandparents, John and Mary Fanning, left Northern Ireland with their children, and miraculously survived an horrific voyage to Australia. On her father's side, Denise uncovers the humour she’s looking for, in her great grandmother Betsy Drysdale, but the flip side of Betsy’s life is one of a sad struggle with alcoholism and despair.

programme.title: Jeopardy!

programme.title: Letters And Numbers
programme.desc: Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show. Join host Richard Morecroft along with maths whiz Lily Serna and wordsmith David Astle.

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Tonight: The Cecchetti Ballet Method, the fearless Nancy Wake, Internment of Japanese Civilians in Australia and the Aussie Boomers at the Olympics - four topics, zero overlap, max intrigue.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Stage and screen actress, Essie Davis, is keen to delve into her secretive paternal history. Peeling back the layers, Essie gains a greater appreciation of her beloved father's character and discovers independent, unconventional women who mirror Essie's celebrated on-screen personality, Miss Phyrne Fisher.

programme.title: Insight
programme.desc: Escaping the jaws of a great white shark, surviving 10 days lost in the bush without food and shelter, recovering from a deadly disease but facing long-term health problems or surviving methanol poisoning only to become permanently blind. When is a lucky escape not so lucky?

programme.title: Dateline

programme.title: Living Black
programme.desc: Ursula Yovich's love of music and acting has often combined to create award winning performances. But what does it take to go "All In" on her characters? Karla Grant finds out.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: When the granddaughter of a powerful Sao Paulo construction dynasty is kidnapped for a colossal ransom, Menck leads the response. As the operation progresses, intelligence begins to paint a far more complicated picture of the victim. Events take a dramatic and unexpected turn, while back at GATE headquarters, an internal affairs investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of Menck's wife begins to gather momentum.

programme.title: Too Cool To Kill
programme.desc: While pursuing his lifelong dream of landing a starring role, amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man. However, unbeknownst to Mr. Wei, the new gig has landed him directly in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
programme.desc: In 1970s England, the head of MI6 dispatches an agent to meet with a Hungarian general who knows the identity of a Soviet spy in the organisation's ranks. However, the mission goes wrong and the general dies before he can reveal the information. Under-secretary Oliver Lacon calls veteran agent George Smiley back from forced retirement to ferret out the mole and stop the flow of vital British secrets to the Russians. Stars Gary Oldman, Colin Firth and Mark Strong.

programme.title: The Monk And The Gun
programme.desc: A Bhutanese satire in which democracy arrives in the Himalayan kingdom. As villagers prepare for a mock election, a mysterious monk seeks a rare gun, intertwining fate, faith, and politics.

programme.title: The Darkside
programme.desc: Director Warwick Thornton assembles a collection of poignant, sad, funny, and absurd true ghost stories from across Australia with some of Australia's most iconic actors as the storytellers. Stars Aaron Pederson, Jack Charles and Deborah Mailman.

programme.title: Madison
programme.desc: At the center of the family story is 13-year-old protagonist Madison, for whom cycle racing means just everything! She gives her all to emulate her cool and successful cycle-pro father. But when the talented and ambitious young racer has to unwillingly swap saddles for a mountain bike things go haywire.

programme.title: Too Cool To Kill
programme.desc: While pursuing his lifelong dream of landing a starring role, amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man. However, unbeknownst to Mr. Wei, the new gig has landed him directly in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Master Cheng (a Spice For Life)
programme.desc: Following the death of his wife, professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote village in Finland to connect with an old Finnish friend he once met in Shanghai. Upon arrival, nobody in the village seems to know his friend but local cafe owner Sirkka offers him accommodation. In return Cheng helps her in the kitchen, surprising the locals with the delights of Chinese cuisine.

programme.title: Discovering Film: Whoopi Goldberg
programme.desc: Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the `golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: The Snows Of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: The life of celebrated American writer Harry Street (Gregory Peck) flashes back before his eyes as he lies dying from a wound suffered at the foot of Tanzania's Mount Kilimanjaro. As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

programme.title: Alick & Albert
programme.desc: Even though they live worlds apart, Torres Strait artist and activist Alick Tipoti and His Serene Highness Prince Albert II of Monaco unite to help protect the Ocean.

programme.title: The New Boy
programme.desc: From Dirty Films and Scarlett Pictures comes writer/director Warwick Thornton’s The New Boy. In a remote monastery in 1940s Australia, a mission for Aboriginal children is run by a renegade nun, Sister Eileen. A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

programme.title: Samson And Delilah
programme.desc: Samson and Delilah's world is small - an isolated Aboriginal community in the Central Australian desert. When tragedy strikes, they turn their backs on home and embark on a journey of survival. Lost, unwanted and alone, they discover that life isn't always fair but love never judges. Directed by Warwick Thornton and stars Rowan McNamara and Marissa Gibson.

programme.title: Green Bush
programme.desc: Over one heartbreaking but empowering night, local DJ Kenny realises his job at the community radio station is about more than just playing music. Kenny jokes that his Green Bush show is broadcast to a 'captive' audience - namely the local prison. While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence. Green Bush is a celebration of an era of music, working for a cause and getting things done. But not in the way you would expect.

programme.desc: Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

programme.title: Donal's Real Time Recipes
programme.desc: Donal is turning up the heat and taking tastebuds on a trip with fast, fuss-free recipes inspired by global flavours.

programme.title: Shane Delia's Malta
programme.desc: Shane Delia arrives in Malta to see how modern Maltese cuisine is grounded in its traditions and history. Starting in the fishing village of Marsaxlokk.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The public face of Colombia has changed immensely over the past few years and is still changing for the better. Tony travels through several regions of the country from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Fillers

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Stilton has been known as the King of English cheeses for more than two centuries and unlike its traditional cousins it has never been copied elsewhere. Despite its famous name it has never been made in Stilton and Will Studd visits historic Quenby Hall where the cheese was invented before investigating how it is made and the origins of its outstanding reputation.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia
programme.desc: Adam masters the art of making traditional Danish Smørrebrød in Copenhagen, before travelling to the west coast to Bork Havn to learn how Vikings lived and ate. Next Adam’s in Stockholm, Sweden in the kitchen of Michelin star chef Niklas Ekstedt, who’s combined the Viking diet and pre-electricity heating to invent his own style. Adam visits everyday Swedes hosting a new project called Hoffice, a cutting-edge culture-changing idea turning residential spaces in Stockholm into shared work spaces.

programme.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
programme.desc: This time on Eating dirty, David is in Palermo to explore one of the loudest and wildest street markets in Europe, is then fed some of the freshest seafood available in Siracusa, Sicily, before winding down and soaking up the aperitivo culture in the heart of Florence.

programme.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty

programme.desc: Denise Drysdale takes a DNA test, and it’s no surprise to find her family hails from Scotland. But it is a shock to discover she also has DNA links to Northern Ireland. Denise finds her maternal 3 times great grandparents, John and Mary Fanning, left Northern Ireland with their children, and miraculously survived an horrific voyage to Australia. On her father's side, Denise uncovers the humour she’s looking for, in her great grandmother Betsy Drysdale, but the flip side of Betsy’s life is one of a sad struggle with alcoholism and despair.

programme.title: Jeopardy!
programme.desc: Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Stage and screen actress, Essie Davis, is keen to delve into her secretive paternal history. Peeling back the layers, Essie gains a greater appreciation of her beloved father's character and discovers independent, unconventional women who mirror Essie's celebrated on-screen personality, Miss Phyrne Fisher.

programme.title: Insight
programme.desc: Escaping the jaws of a great white shark, surviving 10 days lost in the bush without food and shelter, recovering from a deadly disease but facing long-term health problems or surviving methanol poisoning only to become permanently blind. When is a lucky escape not so lucky?

programme.title: Dateline
programme.desc: Dateline follows a helicopter rescue team delivering urgent medical care across Papua New Guinea. With severe medicine and doctor shortages, what does the future hold for our nearest neighbour?

programme.title: SBS World News Late
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Living Black
programme.desc: Ursula Yovich's love of music and acting has often combined to create award winning performances. But what does it take to go "All In" on her characters? Karla Grant finds out.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: When the granddaughter of a powerful Sao Paulo construction dynasty is kidnapped for a colossal ransom, Menck leads the response. As the operation progresses, intelligence begins to paint a far more complicated picture of the victim. Events take a dramatic and unexpected turn, while back at GATE headquarters, an internal affairs investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of Menck's wife begins to gather momentum.

programme.title: Too Cool To Kill
programme.desc: While pursuing his lifelong dream of landing a starring role, amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man. However, unbeknownst to Mr. Wei, the new gig has landed him directly in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
programme.desc: In 1970s England, the head of MI6 dispatches an agent to meet with a Hungarian general who knows the identity of a Soviet spy in the organisation's ranks. However, the mission goes wrong and the general dies before he can reveal the information. Under-secretary Oliver Lacon calls veteran agent George Smiley back from forced retirement to ferret out the mole and stop the flow of vital British secrets to the Russians. Stars Gary Oldman, Colin Firth and Mark Strong.

programme.title: The Monk And The Gun
programme.desc: A Bhutanese satire in which democracy arrives in the Himalayan kingdom. As villagers prepare for a mock election, a mysterious monk seeks a rare gun, intertwining fate, faith, and politics.

programme.title: The Darkside
programme.desc: Director Warwick Thornton assembles a collection of poignant, sad, funny, and absurd true ghost stories from across Australia with some of Australia's most iconic actors as the storytellers. Stars Aaron Pederson, Jack Charles and Deborah Mailman.

programme.title: Madison
programme.desc: At the center of the family story is 13-year-old protagonist Madison, for whom cycle racing means just everything! She gives her all to emulate her cool and successful cycle-pro father. But when the talented and ambitious young racer has to unwillingly swap saddles for a mountain bike things go haywire.

programme.title: Too Cool To Kill
programme.desc: While pursuing his lifelong dream of landing a starring role, amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man. However, unbeknownst to Mr. Wei, the new gig has landed him directly in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Master Cheng (a Spice For Life)
programme.desc: Following the death of his wife, professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote village in Finland to connect with an old Finnish friend he once met in Shanghai. Upon arrival, nobody in the village seems to know his friend but local cafe owner Sirkka offers him accommodation. In return Cheng helps her in the kitchen, surprising the locals with the delights of Chinese cuisine.

programme.title: Discovering Film: Whoopi Goldberg
programme.desc: Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the `golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: The Snows Of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: The life of celebrated American writer Harry Street (Gregory Peck) flashes back before his eyes as he lies dying from a wound suffered at the foot of Tanzania's Mount Kilimanjaro. As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

programme.title: Alick & Albert
programme.desc: Even though they live worlds apart, Torres Strait artist and activist Alick Tipoti and His Serene Highness Prince Albert II of Monaco unite to help protect the Ocean.

programme.title: The New Boy
programme.desc: From Dirty Films and Scarlett Pictures comes writer/director Warwick Thornton’s The New Boy. In a remote monastery in 1940s Australia, a mission for Aboriginal children is run by a renegade nun, Sister Eileen. A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

programme.title: Samson And Delilah
programme.desc: Samson and Delilah's world is small - an isolated Aboriginal community in the Central Australian desert. When tragedy strikes, they turn their backs on home and embark on a journey of survival. Lost, unwanted and alone, they discover that life isn't always fair but love never judges. Directed by Warwick Thornton and stars Rowan McNamara and Marissa Gibson.

programme.title: Green Bush
programme.desc: Over one heartbreaking but empowering night, local DJ Kenny realises his job at the community radio station is about more than just playing music. Kenny jokes that his Green Bush show is broadcast to a 'captive' audience - namely the local prison. While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence. Green Bush is a celebration of an era of music, working for a cause and getting things done. But not in the way you would expect.

Despite its famous name it has never been made in Stilton and Will Studd visits historic Quenby Hall where the cheese was invented before investigating how it is made and the origins of its outstanding reputation.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia

Adam visits everyday Swedes hosting a new project called Hoffice, a cutting-edge culture-changing idea turning residential spaces in Stockholm into shared work spaces.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia teaches us how to add elegant touches to weeknight meals, while keeping them simple - fennel and Asian pear salad, cheesy veal chops with cabbage, she also prepares a delightful lentil crostini.

programme.desc: Tom is back at his Michelin starred pub for a brand new series. Today his highly skilled team of chefs are hard at work making a gorgeous roast beef dish for the specials menu.

programme.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programme.desc: In Stockholm, Sweden, Adam is inside the daring kitchen of Chef Niklas Ekstedt's Michelin restaurant of his namesake, Ekstedt. In return Cheng helps her in the kitchen, surprising the locals with the delights of Chinese cuisine.

As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

Directed by Warwick Thornton and stars Rowan McNamara and Marissa Gibson.

programme.desc: Over one heartbreaking but empowering night, local DJ Kenny realises his job at the community radio station is about more than just playing music. Kenny jokes that his Green Bush show is broadcast to a 'captive' audience - namely the local prison. While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence. Green Bush is a celebration of an era of music, working for a cause and getting things done. But not in the way you would expect.

Adam meets Chef and Restaurateur Mathias Pilblad who's opened the only Swedish meatball restaurant in Sweden, and cooks up a classic Swedish meatball dish.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

programme.title: Food Safari
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara explores the many cuisines of Darwin, including recipes from the city's large Greek population, the numerous Asian fares represented in the area as well as classics from local Indigenous cooks. From Chinese inspired fresh mud crab steamed with rice wine, to barramundi cooked in paperbark on a perfect beach, and from a Greek Sunday lunch to a Thai feast, this is a celebration of Australia's diverse culinary landscape.

programme.desc: Michael's journey has brought him to Lee on the Solent in Hampshire to the training centre of Britain's fourth emergency service, Her Majesty's Coastguard. Michael's next stop on his coastal travels is the great maritime city of Portsmouth. Here he meets the Queen's Harbour Master, whose office oversees more than 200,000 maritime movements through the port each year.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: The final leg of Michael's South Coast adventure begins in Fishbourne, the location of one of the most significant Roman sites in Britain. Heading into East Sussex, Michael makes for a British resort synonymous with seaside jaunts, Brighton.

programme.desc: Stage and screen actress, Essie Davis, is keen to delve into her secretive paternal history. Peeling back the layers, Essie gains a greater appreciation of her beloved father's character and discovers independent, unconventional women who mirror Essie's celebrated on-screen personality, Miss Phyrne Fisher.

programme.title: Insight
programme.desc: Escaping the jaws of a great white shark, surviving 10 days lost in the bush without food and shelter, recovering from a deadly disease but facing long-term health problems or surviving methanol poisoning only to become permanently blind. When is a lucky escape not so lucky?

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: When the granddaughter of a powerful Sao Paulo construction dynasty is kidnapped for a colossal ransom, Menck leads the response. As the operation progresses, intelligence begins to paint a far more complicated picture of the victim. Events take a dramatic and unexpected turn, while back at GATE headquarters, an internal affairs investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of Menck's wife begins to gather momentum.

programme.title: Too Cool To Kill
programme.desc: While pursuing his lifelong dream of landing a starring role, amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man. However, unbeknownst to Mr. Wei, the new gig has landed him directly in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
programme.desc: In 1970s England, the head of MI6 dispatches an agent to meet with a Hungarian general who knows the identity of a Soviet spy in the organisation's ranks. However, the mission goes wrong and the general dies before he can reveal the information. Under-secretary Oliver Lacon calls veteran agent George Smiley back from forced retirement to ferret out the mole and stop the flow of vital British secrets to the Russians. Stars Gary Oldman, Colin Firth and Mark Strong.

programme.title: The Monk And The Gun
programme.desc: A Bhutanese satire in which democracy arrives in the Himalayan kingdom. As villagers prepare for a mock election, a mysterious monk seeks a rare gun, intertwining fate, faith, and politics.

programme.title: The Darkside

programme.title: Madison
programme.desc: At the center of the family story is 13-year-old protagonist Madison, for whom cycle racing means just everything! She gives her all to emulate her cool and successful cycle-pro father. But when the talented and ambitious young racer has to unwillingly swap saddles for a mountain bike things go haywire.

programme.title: Too Cool To Kill
programme.desc: While pursuing his lifelong dream of landing a starring role, amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man. However, unbeknownst to Mr. Wei, the new gig has landed him directly in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Master Cheng (a Spice For Life)
programme.desc: Following the death of his wife, professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote village in Finland to connect with an old Finnish friend he once met in Shanghai. Upon arrival, nobody in the village seems to know his friend but local cafe owner Sirkka offers him accommodation. In return Cheng helps her in the kitchen, surprising the locals with the delights of Chinese cuisine.

programme.title: Discovering Film: Whoopi Goldberg
programme.desc: Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the `golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: The Snows Of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: The life of celebrated American writer Harry Street (Gregory Peck) flashes back before his eyes as he lies dying from a wound suffered at the foot of Tanzania's Mount Kilimanjaro. As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

programme.title: Alick & Albert
programme.desc: Even though they live worlds apart, Torres Strait artist and activist Alick Tipoti and His Serene Highness Prince Albert II of Monaco unite to help protect the Ocean.

programme.title: The New Boy
programme.desc: From Dirty Films and Scarlett Pictures comes writer/director Warwick Thornton’s The New Boy. In a remote monastery in 1940s Australia, a mission for Aboriginal children is run by a renegade nun, Sister Eileen. A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

programme.title: Samson And Delilah
programme.desc: Samson and Delilah's world is small - an isolated Aboriginal community in the Central Australian desert. When tragedy strikes, they turn their backs on home and embark on a journey of survival. Lost, unwanted and alone, they discover that life isn't always fair but love never judges. Directed by Warwick Thornton and stars Rowan McNamara and Marissa Gibson.

programme.title: Green Bush
programme.desc: Over one heartbreaking but empowering night, local DJ Kenny realises his job at the community radio station is about more than just playing music. Kenny jokes that his Green Bush show is broadcast to a 'captive' audience - namely the local prison. While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence. Green Bush is a celebration of an era of music, working for a cause and getting things done. But not in the way you would expect.

Upon arrival, nobody in the village seems to know his friend but local cafe owner Sirkka offers him accommodation. In return Cheng helps her in the kitchen, surprising the locals with the delights of Chinese cuisine.

programme.title: The Snows Of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: The life of celebrated American writer Harry Street (Gregory Peck) flashes back before his eyes as he lies dying from a wound suffered at the foot of Tanzania's Mount Kilimanjaro. As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

programme.title: Alick & Albert

programme.title: The New Boy
programme.desc: From Dirty Films and Scarlett Pictures comes writer/director Warwick Thornton’s The New Boy. In a remote monastery in 1940s Australia, a mission for Aboriginal children is run by a renegade nun, Sister Eileen. A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

programme.title: Samson And Delilah
programme.desc: Samson and Delilah's world is small - an isolated Aboriginal community in the Central Australian desert. When tragedy strikes, they turn their backs on home and embark on a journey of survival. Lost, unwanted and alone, they discover that life isn't always fair but love never judges. Directed by Warwick Thornton and stars Rowan McNamara and Marissa Gibson.

programme.title: Green Bush
programme.desc: Over one heartbreaking but empowering night, local DJ Kenny realises his job at the community radio station is about more than just playing music. Kenny jokes that his Green Bush show is broadcast to a 'captive' audience - namely the local prison. While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence. Green Bush is a celebration of an era of music, working for a cause and getting things done. But not in the way you would expect.

Carroll).

A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence. In return Cheng helps her in the kitchen, surprising the locals with the delights of Chinese cuisine.

As he is tended to by his traveling companion, Helen (Susan Hayward), he recalls many things: his first wife and Paris literary inspiration, Cynthia Green (Ava Gardner) ; his second wife, Countess Liz (Hildegarde Neff) ; and his formative years with uncle Bill (Leo G. Carroll).

A new charge is delivered in the dead of night – a boy who appears to have special powers. When the monastery takes possession of a precious relic, a large carving of Christ on the cross, the new boy encounters Jesus for the first time and is transfixed.

Directed by Warwick Thornton and stars Rowan McNamara and Marissa Gibson.

While taking requests from those on the inside and out, Kenny has to cope with the results of a wild night outside and learn his place in the circle of violence.
